description: An authenticated actor (ENT-20) — user, service, or node — the subject of access grants and audit. The on-disk principal.json projection of the replicated `principal:<uuid>` CRDT value. Mirrored by zetta::Principal in include/zetta/principal.hpp and enforced by Node::load_principals() in src/core/node.cpp — keep the three in sync.

created.description: ISO-8601 UTC creation stamp (millisecond precision, trailing 'Z').

id.description: The principal's UUID — its CRDT key and on-disk folder name. Present in principal.json (where the folder name is the source of truth) and omitted from the CRDT value (the key carries it).

kind.description: What sort of actor this is.

title: Principal
